title: Physics-Informed Neural Networks
wrong_turns: A weak answer says only that the neural network fits data.

title: Partial Differential Equations

title: Operator Learning
wrong_turns: A weak answer says only that the model is fast.
The training family is not named.
Only one resolution is tested.
The output looks plausible but physical quantities are not checked.
The model is used on a new boundary type without evidence.
plain_correction: Operator learning tries to learn the machine that turns one field into another field.
first_principles_test: change resolution, coefficients, boundary conditions, or forcing and check whether the predicted field still satisfies the scientific quantity being claimed

title: Surrogate Modeling
wrong_turns: A weak answer treats speed as trust.
The surrogate is described without its use range.
The edge cases are not tested.
The output metric ignores the decision people actually make.
The full solver is never used again for spot checks.
plain_correction: A surrogate is a faster stand-in for a slower trusted process.
first_principles_test: compare against the full solver on new cases near the edge of the intended use

title: Uncertainty And Generalization
wrong_turns: A weak answer reports one score without saying what changed.
Only familiar cases are reported.
The test set differs from training only in name.
Rare regimes are averaged away.
No one states what condition would make the model unusable.
plain_correction: This topic asks when a prediction should be believed on a case the model did not learn from.
first_principles_test: move one important condition outside the training range and measure the first failure

title: Neural Differential Equations
wrong_turns: A weak answer says only that Neural Differential Equations is useful without naming the observed evidence, hidden quantity, mathematical move, and changed-case test.
The model is tested only over short times.
Small rate errors accumulate unnoticed.
Known conservation or stability behavior is not checked.
The learned rate fits noise instead of mechanism.
plain_correction: A neural differential equation learns the missing rule for how a system changes.
first_principles_test: run longer than the training window and check whether small rate errors accumulate into drift

title: Symbolic Regression And Model Discovery
wrong_turns: A weak answer trusts a neat formula because it fits the original data.
Important variables were never measured.
The formula is selected only on the original data.
Noise creates a fake term.
The search space could not express the real mechanism.
plain_correction: Symbolic regression searches for a short formula that explains measured behavior.
first_principles_test: remove a needed variable, add noise, or test a new experiment and see whether the formula still predicts

title: Foundation Models For PDEs
